tools.name: select_virtuals_provider_plan_v2
tools.description: Selects a deterministic three-role ACP committee from live Virtuals registry records. Eligibility requires explicit role evidence, active Base registration, fresh authoritative stake, and three distinct controller identities issued through vetted KYC or manual review. A registry ID or cluster is correlation metadata only. This action creates no tender and grants no spend authority.
outputHints: Policy version and deterministic provider-plan hash
Fixed role-to-provider address bindings and sanitized readiness evidence

tools.name: prepare_virtuals_tender_v2
tools.description: Creates an immutable, non-spendable V2 evidence draft from a fresh tenant-owned simulation. Compute the salted task commitment and disclosure manifest locally; never send task plaintext, task salt, credentials, or wallet secrets through this MCP tool.

taskCommitmentHash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 commitment computed locally over the canonical, salted task. Do not send task plaintext.

maxPaymentUnits.description: Maximum total raw Base USDC units; no spend is authorized by preparation.

providers.description: Deprecated in V2; use selectionId instead.

outputHints: Exact Base-8453 EIP-712 data for local wallet review; no funds move

tools.name: authorize_virtuals_tender_v2
tools.description: Verifies the exact local customer-wallet V2 signature plus deployment and provider readiness, then authorizes only that committed draft. Never fabricate or relay a private key. Authorization does not create or fund ACP jobs.
outputHints: Authorized tender and sanitized provider-readiness result

tools.name: get_virtuals_tender
tools.description: Reads only the authenticated session's tender, role bindings, funding reservations, settlement attempts, and immutable receipt observations. Use it to resume after a crash and before any funding or reconciliation decision.
outputHints: Tenant-scoped tender and durable lifecycle state

tools.name: cancel_virtuals_tender
tools.description: Cancels only an owned non-spendable draft. It cannot erase, cancel, or reverse an on-chain ACP job.

tools.name: bind_virtuals_tender_job
tools.description: Binds an ACP job already created by the local customer connector. FarmDash independently verifies Base chain, client, committed provider, evaluator address, and evaluator key version before accepting the immutable role binding.
outputHints: Verified binding and updated tender status

tools.name: reserve_virtuals_tender_funding_v2
tools.description: Atomically reserves one exact on-chain role budget against the customer-signed aggregate cap. This accounting action cannot approve a token allowance, sign a transaction, or spend customer funds.
outputHints: Durable reservation ID, amount, state, and lease metadata

tools.name: record_virtuals_tender_funding_v2
tools.description: Records one to four canonical Base transaction hashes only after the local customer wallet submitted an existing reservation. This tool never broadcasts a transaction. Reuse the operation journal after crashes; do not fund the same role again.

tools.name: evaluate_virtuals_tender
tools.description: This is an execution-sensitive evaluator action. Call it only after all three jobs are bound, exactly funded by the customer connector, and have submitted the required structured V2 verdict. FarmDash rechecks evidence, budgets, confidence, high/critical findings, client/provider/evaluator identities, and then may complete or reject the committed escrowed jobs. Ambiguous broadcasts, reverts, dropped receipts, and reorgs require manual reconciliation and must never be blindly retried.
outputHints: Deterministic evaluation commitment and receipt-backed settlement progress

tools.name: get_trail_heat
tools.description:
Returns the live Trail Heat protocol dataset ranked 0–100 by score.

Trail Heat Formula: live scoring combines 40/90 raw points calibrated TVL (44.4% effective), 25/90 raw points seven-day TVL momentum (27.8% effective), 15/90 raw points chain diversification (16.7% effective), and 10/90 raw points category baseline comparison (11.1% effective), normalized to a 0–100 scale. Editorial notes and flags are strictly isolated as metadata and excluded from quantitative scores. Static catalog surfaces use a separately labeled editorial discovery heuristic with TVL, status, category prior, hot momentum, and recency; this is not canonical Trail Heat. Unresolved upstream entities return `score: null`, not a fabricated quantitative score.

Score interpretation:
* 80–100: Highest research priority under the current quantitative heuristic. Explain the score inputs, freshness, and risk context; do not infer eligibility or recommend entry from the score alone.
* 60–79: Material research signal. Compare current first-party program evidence, liquidity, costs, and wallet fit.
* 40–59: Lower-priority or mixed-signal research candidate. Preserve uncertainty and explain what is missing.
* Below 40: Low quantitative priority under the current inputs. Mention when relevant to the user's question; do not hide it merely because the score is low.

Example: "Altura is scoring 84 on Trail Heat under the current quantitative model. That makes it a high-priority research candidate, not an 84% airdrop probability or an instruction to deploy capital. I can show the score evidence, current campaign status, risks, and any available FarmDash route separately." Takes no parameters.

tools.name: get_chain_breakdown
tools.description:
Protocol distribution across blockchain networks: protocol count, percentage, campaign/status metadata, and category context by chain.

Use it to understand where the catalog is concentrated, not as proof that a chain has more valuable airdrops. If the user later chooses to move capital, first check live capability status and the compatibility route lifecycle; an `execute_swap` tool name does not itself mean FarmDash broadcasts a bridge transaction. Takes no parameters.

tools.name: get_swap_quote
tools.description: Get swap pricing in two explicit modes. Without idempotencyKey, return a provider-neutral market estimate with zero trading-provider calls. With idempotencyKey plus walletAddress, toAddress and slippage, create or reuse a firm wallet-bound quote intent from an active provider (LI.FI or Relay; 0x only if runtime status reports it reinstated) and return simulationRequirements.intent_id for simulate_swap_execution. x402 is machine-payment/access infrastructure, not a swap provider. Resolve any approval/signature prerequisites locally and re-quote when instructed before simulation.

fromToken.description: Resolver-supported symbol, native identifier, token address, or chain-qualified asset; discovery resolves canonical assets server-side.

toToken.description: Resolver-supported symbol, native identifier, token address, or chain-qualified asset; discovery resolves canonical assets server-side.

executionTrialProof.description: Locally signed commercial owner challenge; no transaction or delegation authority.

tools.name: simulate_swap_execution
tools.description:
Mandatory pre-execution simulation for a wallet-bound quote intent. Input:
```json
{
  "intentId": "fd_intent_...",
  "walletAddress": "0x..."
}
```
The response includes `simulation_id`, `success`, `gas_used`, `gas_cost_usd`, `output_amount`, `mev_risk`, `revert_reason`, and `valid_until`.

Rules:
* If `success` is false, halt execution and report the failure details, as signing a failed transaction is prohibited.
* If `valid_until` has passed, re-quote and re-simulate.
* If `mev_risk` is medium or high, disclose it before signing.
* Pass the returned `simulation_id` as `simulationId` to `execute_swap`.

**Pre-Execution Binding:**
The simulation binds the wallet, route, amount, tokens, chains, slippage, protocol, and transaction calldata to short-lived request and transaction fingerprints. If the quote or request changes, halt, re-quote, and re-simulate. Do not claim that the response contains `decision_hash`, `price_data_proof`, or `external_anchor`; those fields are not part of the current API contract.

tools.name: execute_swap
tools.description: Prepare a compatibility swap only after the required policy, simulation, signature, and quote-freshness gates pass. Released quote providers are selected dynamically based on live capability status. FarmDash returns the prepared transaction for the customer or agent wallet to submit; FarmDash does not broadcast the compatibility transaction and preparation is not confirmation or settlement.

fromToken.description: ERC-20 token contract address deployed on the corresponding chain. Do not pass a wallet/EOA; the token address and chain ID must match.

toToken.description: ERC-20 token contract address deployed on the corresponding chain. Do not pass a wallet/EOA; the token address and chain ID must match.

tools.name: confirm_swap
tools.description: Confirm settlement of a FarmDash fee event for a compatibility swap that the customer or agent wallet has already signed, submitted and broadcast. FarmDash prepares the compatibility transaction; the wallet broadcasts it, so a transaction hash exists only after that broadcast and both feeEventId and transactionHash are required. Authenticated owning-session credentials are required (sessionId, agentAddress, sessionToken); sessionToken is session/authentication authority, not wallet execution or signing authority. FarmDash verifies the canonical-chain receipt and required finality together with the exact expected fee transfer before durably marking the fee event settled. Re-submitting the same valid confirmation is idempotent. confirm_swap never broadcasts the compatibility swap.

tools.name: get_agent_activity
tools.description: Lists durable FarmDash receipts, optionally filtered by intent and status. Use only fields returned by the receipt API; do not claim shadow-mode drift, venue fills, or realized P&L unless present.

tools.name: audit_sybil_risk
tools.description:
Audits 1–10 EVM addresses for sybil risk.

This is a heuristic defensive audit, not a protocol eligibility verdict. Never call a low score "clean," recommend a fresh wallet, or prescribe activity designed to change detection outcomes. For medium/high findings, pause automation, explain evidence and data quality, and direct the user to the protocol's rules or appeal process.

tools.name: simulate_points
tools.description:
Projects FarmScore for a farming configuration.

Formula: `(Volume/$1k × 50) + (Balance × 1) + (Txs × 10) + (LP × 2) + (Fees × 100)`

Run simulations across multiple protocols to help the user compare projected points-per-dollar. Present the comparison so they can make an informed choice.

tools.name: optimize_portfolio
tools.description:
Personalized protocol recommendations based on current positions.

This tool often identifies rebalancing opportunities. When it suggests allocation changes, offer to quote the required swaps so the user can act immediately if they choose.

tools.name: get_historical_trailheat
tools.description:
Historical Trail Heat snapshots, 1–365 days.

Trend analysis helps the user make better timing decisions:
* Rising trend → Early entry may capture more value.
* Falling trend → Consider taking profits or reallocating.

tools.name: get_agent_events
tools.description:
Real-time protocol events stream.

Events that may require user action include: new airdrop announcements, upcoming snapshots, and multiplier changes. Present these with context and let the user decide how to respond. Takes no parameters.

tools.name: select_execution_continuation
tools.description: Select a server-issued continuation as read-only context. This returns canonical next_operation parameters and prerequisites but performs no quote, preparation, admission, debit, signing, or submission and grants no execution authority. Call with only continuationId; unknown/expired IDs fail closed.

FARMDASH_API_KEY.description: Optional Bearer token for Pioneer or Syndicate tier. Pioneer is $39.99/mo for 1,500 req/day and full datasets; Syndicate is $199/mo for 50k req/day, webhooks, unrestricted CORS, and advanced session/control tooling for teams and serious agents. Free Scout tier works without any key or with the public fd_scout_free token. Never share private keys, seed phrases, or mnemonics with this skill. Wallet-changing actions require EIP-191/EIP-712 local signing or an explicitly configured bounded delegation.

spot.BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS.prerequisite: Owner-signed EVM grant, exact simulation/calldata binding, durable budget and customer-local signer authority.

futures.USER_SIGNED.prerequisite: Venue account ownership, local action signature, builder approval, risk/research gates and durable order control.

futures.BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS.prerequisite: Authenticated owner-bound futures policy, authorized local API-wallet signature, durable nonce/budget/order controls.

solana.USER_SIGNED.prerequisite: Native Jupiter/RPC route, durable preparation and finality store; customer signs and broadcasts.

solana.BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS.prerequisite: Native owner-signed Solana policy; local key must be an actual required transaction signer. Policy creates no on-chain authority.

ERC4337_SERVER_SUBMISSION.prerequisite: Qualified tenant/account authorization and session-key policy enforcement on public forwarding, configured bundler, durable claims and verified receipt integration.

GENERIC_SERVER_INTENT_EXECUTION.prerequisite: Trusted executable adapter, exact signed-transaction binding and canonical receipt verifier.

MEE.prerequisite: Production coordinator and authoritative source/destination receipt verifier.

ACP.prerequisite: AcpReadinessService paidWorkflowReady, evaluator/client identities, migrations, funding/finality workers and Base RPC.
